# D.L. Narasimhan

> Personal site of D.L. Narasimhan, Applications Development Manager at UPS India Technology Center. Engineering leader (20+ engineers) focused on AI agent enablement, data governance for AI, and product engineering for high-volume logistics systems, with 17+ years of hands-on software development (.NET, C#, ASP.NET Core, system design).

Key facts:
- Role: Applications Development Manager, UPS India Technology Center
- Leads 20+ engineers delivering 6 applications for a UPS business line, including major partner integrations
- Works on data governance with policy makers, portfolio managers, and senior leadership across a 2,000+ person technology organization in India
- Career: .NET developer (2007) → international experience in Belgium (2012) → Infosys (2015) → Siemens (2020) → UPS (2023)
- Recognition: Best Project Award (2025), ADM Champion Award (Q2 2025), Maximum Monetary Value Project (2025)
